title: Definitions Entry — The Day Count of a Rebuilt Cycle's Interest, Belrose Promotional Financing Plans

# Definitions Entry — The Day Count of a Rebuilt Cycle's Interest, Belrose Promotional Financing Plans

**The interest one cycle carries** in a rebuilt payment on a Belrose Promotional Financing Plan runs over one of three conventions.

1. Where the plan stands past due at the handling date, the interest runs on the actual number of days from the closing date of the most recent statement to the handling date, on a year of three hundred and sixty-five days.
2. Where the plan stands active and automatic payment is in force on it, the interest runs on the actual number of days from the closing date of the most recent statement to the handling date, on a year of three hundred and sixty days.
3. In every other case, the interest runs on the term's nominal billing cycle length, on a year of three hundred and sixty-five days.

In each case the figure is rounded to the cent.

## The nominal billing cycle by term

| Term | 6-Month Deferred Interest | 12-Month Deferred Interest | 18-Month Deferred Interest | 24-Month Equal Payment | 36-Month Equal Payment | 48-Month Bridal Equal Payment |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Nominal billing cycle, calendar days | 30 | 30 | 30 | 30 | 30 | 30 |

The nominal billing cycle stands at 30 calendar days on every promotional term.

## The three conventions on one set of figures (hypothetical)

A balance of 6,000.00 USD priced at 12 percent, the most recent statement having closed 41 days before the handling date:

| The plan | The interest one cycle carries |
|---|---|
| Past due | 6,000.00 USD at 12 percent for 41 days on a year of three hundred and sixty-five days, that is 80.88 USD |
| Active with automatic payment in force | 6,000.00 USD at 12 percent for 41 days on a year of three hundred and sixty days, that is 82.00 USD |
| Any other case | 6,000.00 USD at 12 percent for 30 days on a year of three hundred and sixty-five days, that is 59.18 USD |
